name: HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance
description: Measures distance by sound, 2-400 cm, in a narrow cone. Needs 5 V, and its ECHO pin answers at 5 V: put a 1 kΩ + 2 kΩ divider (or any 1:2 pair) between ECHO and the board, or the pin may be damaged. The HC-SR04+ / RCWL-1601 3.3 V versions need no divider.

options.label: Also count as presence when something is closer than (cm, 0 = off)
